problem:
What linear transformation is represented by the following matrix
$[\begin{aligned}1 & 4 \\ 0 & 1\end{aligned}]?$

choices.value: A stretch of scale factor $4$ in the $x$-direction
A stretch of scale factor $4$ in the $y$-direction
A vertical shear with a shear factor of $4$
A horizontal shear with a shear factor of $\frac{1}{4}$
A horizontal shear with a shear factor of $4$

activity_context.topic_title: Shear and Stretch as Linear Transformations
